notes.title: We're excited to announce the latest updates for NINJA!
notes.content:
Builder icon now correctly appears in the slot in the BUILDERS building.
Improved mana and gold animation in wave menus.
Fixed issue with characters not shooting from towers.
Resolved character freezing bug after killing someone, allowing for continued attacks.
Added functionality to convert free experience into character experience.
Werewolf now patrols on the beach scene as intended.
Confirmation popup for character upgrades now always active with grayed-out indicators for missing resources or experience.
Bowstring now releases and arrows appear in clan camp arenas.
Victory now occurs when killing the opposing king in king-versus-king scenarios.
Fixed issue where enemies weren't detecting the player.
Disabled NPC control when interacting with their UI to prevent interference during upgrades.
Heart icon bug in NPC menu fixed by aligning with numbers.
These improvements enhance gameplay and ensure a smoother experience for all NINJA players. Update now to enjoy these enhancements!
